ice_tolerance.reference_policy: same current common nominal values; not previous iteration; no cumulative rebasing
ice_tolerance.dimension_policy: actual dimension = corresponding nominal dimension * (1 + deviation)
ice_tolerance.position_policy: signed normal displacement divided by declared local nominal length
ice_tolerance.direction_policy: signed transverse drift/run relative to the original rink axis
ice_tolerance.shared_by: entire event scene, all shots and cameras
ice_tolerance.nominal_constraints_ref: constraints describe the nominal template; effective metric ties have the declared tolerance
preserved: F/R centres on their connection centreline

carrier endpoints on the same continuous board

nested ring order, row order, C/B/goal order and finite support branches
ice_tolerance.compound_relations: native signed margins also bound row gaps, clearances, side slopes, widths and collinear-carrier endpoints
